title: Fix provider HTTP error recovery and pipeline feedback

commits.message: Fix provider error recovery and pipeline feedback
Record CHG-20260721-010 as tested for next release pool
commits.multi_change_reason: registry metadata update after implementation commit

user_summary: 场景边界 PROVIDER_HTTP_ERROR 后可正确恢复：保留结构化错误、限制自动重试、修复并继续有反馈，且不再把阅读旅程未到阶段当作根因。
technical_summary: PROVIDER_HTTP_ERROR (real incident: HTTP 429 rate limit on boundary_detection) lacked structured error persistence UX, unified recover never resumed boundary_detection (only incremented recovery_attempts), and skip journey check was shown as root failure. Added provider HTTP error snapshot fields/categories, capped auto(3)/manual(5) recovery, wired boundary checkpoint resume, and fixed recovery card feedback/copy.
acceptance_criteria: Retryable HTTP auto max 3; manual max 5
Fix-and-continue shows loading and real reason
Tech details collapsed with HTTP fields
